proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.ability_modifier.minimumUses
proposed_widenings.justification: The activation half already fits the class_feature activation family, but the resource cap needs an explicit floor so modifier-scaled uses can honor RAW minimums.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once)

proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount minimum total floor
proposed_widenings.justification: The temporary HP amount is a normal rolled amount plus an ability modifier, but the total cannot fall below 1. Current DiceExpr models the sum, not the minimum floor on the resolved total.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can give yourself a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1)

proposed_widenings.name: rest_window -> condition_progression (exhaustion -1)
proposed_widenings.justification: The second half is deterministic and not DM agenda, but the passive-operation grammar cannot trigger on finishing a Short Rest and the surface cannot represent decreasing a leveled condition by exactly 1 instead of removing it entirely.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Whenever you finish a Short Rest, your Exhaustion level, if any, decreases by 1.

notes: Composite class_feature shape exists, and the temporary-HP activation mostly fits, but three RAW details are unrepresentable: minimum-1 use floor, minimum-1 temp-HP floor, and short-rest exhaustion decrement. No content file was authored to avoid a misleading partial encoding.
